characters.line: Could grant anything except a want as small as Boof’s. Paid for hers with everything he had left, and one Thursday.

characters.line: Keeps the DAMAGE slips for the Feast of the Uneven Slice: a word at the top, a line for the cause.

characters.name: The figure in plain lines
characters.line: One circle, one rectangle, four lines, two dots. Nobody has said who. The hat rests above, and never lands.
